 Travel
 Travel on a non-commercial chartered or private aircraft
Flight from Winnipeg to Pimicikamak Cree Nation, Manitoba on September 14, 2024 to attend the funeral of Grand Chief of the Assembly of Manitoba Chiefs Cathy Merrick.
Source: the Assembly of Manitoba Chiefs.
I was accompanied by Brad Boudreau, senior policy advisor.
This travel was required in my capacity as Minister of Northern Affairs, Minister responsible for Prairies Economic Development Canada, and Minister responsible for the Canadian Northern Economic Development Agency.
 Travel on a non-commercial chartered or private aircraft 
Flight from Inuvik, Northwest Territories to Whitehorse, Yukon.
Date: August 10, 2023
Source: Yukon Government.
Circumstances: I traveled to Inuvik, Northwest Territories on August 10, 2023 for the signing of the Accord between the Government of Canada, the Inuvialuit Regional Corporation, the Government of the Northwest Territories, and the Government of Yukon for the shared management and regulation of petroleum resources in the Western Arctic - Tariuq (offshore). While in Inuvik, a nearby wildfire caused a deterioration in air quality and the possibility that an evacuation alert would soon be issued. The Premier of Yukon offered for me to accompany him on a chartered flight to Whitehorse and I accepted.
I was accompanied by Ryan Cotter, Director of Communications in my office.
This travel was accepted in exceptional circumstances.
 Travel on a non-commercial chartered or private aircraft on March 31, 2023 to tour the Taltson Hydro Expansion project in the Northwest Territories.
Source: Government of the Northwest Territories.
Circumstances: tour of the Taltson Hydro Expansion project in the Northwest Territories.
I was accompanied by the following members of my staff: Ryan Cotter and Anna Bodnar.
This travel was required in my capacity as Minister of Northern Affairs, Minister responsible for Prairies Economic Development Canada and Minister responsible for the Canadian Northern Economic Development Agency.
